name: grove-delegation-workflow
description: How Kinch delegates work among Grove members based on task type, expertise, and current capacity
steps: Identify task type: Research, Code/Review, Trading, Verification, Infrastructure, Documentation
Match to Grove member expertise: Newton for deep research, Programmer for code review, Budger for trading, etc.
Check member WAKE.md or status for current capacity and blockers
Formulate clear task with context, acceptance criteria, and deadline
Delegate via appropriate channel: subagent for hounds, direct message for humans, Grove Commons for async
Track in Corraler/Pupper or project-pulse.log for accountability
Follow up if no response within deadline window
triggers: Shepherd overflow - too many parallel streams
examples: Code review: Delegate to Programmer with security focus
Research task: Delegate to Newton with Feynman + ELI5 skills
Trading analysis: Delegate to Budger with AEGS parameters
Status check: Delegate to Pupper for weekly hound roundup
Verification: Delegate to Tracker for contact/source confirmation
